author: rhcreations on Sketchfab
note: Redwood illustration by rhcreations, uniformly scaled base to crown to the current catalog’s 116.2 m Hyperion height (the brief gives 116.22 m). It is a generic redwood tree model, not a scan, reconstruction, crown map or girth measurement of Hyperion. The shape, branch structure and foliage are authored; transparent foliage cards are retained as alpha-tested double-sided surfaces. The source’s legacy specular/glossiness materials are converted to metallic/roughness. Guinness documents 116.07 m in 2019; that older measurement does not independently verify the current 2026 catalog figure. No exact location is included.

operations: Convert legacy specular/glossiness materials to metallic/roughness
Simplify triangles toward 55k, error limit 0.012; retain ship linework
JPEG color maps <=1024 px; tree alpha texture PNG <=512 px
Quantize positions/normals/in-range UVs; no compressed meshes or textures
